description:
### Figure Description

**1. Overall Layout**
The figure is a full-width academic pipeline diagram set against a clean, spacious white background. It illustrates a clear left-to-right process flow, composed of six primary stages. The visual style is sophisticated and modern, employing a harmonious palette of soft, muted pastels and clear, serif typography to ensure both aesthetic appeal and legibility.

**2. Components and Connections**

**Element 1: Input Box (Leftmost)**
*   **Shape and Style:** A softly rounded rectangle with a gentle drop shadow. It has a warm, off-white background fill and is outlined with a subtle, light gray border.
*   **Content:**
    *   At the top, the bold serif title "Input".
    *   Below the title are two items, each with an icon:
        *   A code icon (`</>`) followed by the text "Source Code".
        *   A checkbox icon followed by the text "Test Case".

A thin, elegant, medium-dark gray arrow flows from the Input box to the Python Tracer.

**Element 2: Python Tracer**
*   **Shape and Style:** A rounded rectangle filled with a pale sky blue, enclosed by a slightly darker, muted blue border.
*   **Content:**
    *   A small, clean gear icon is centered at the top.
    *   Below the icon is the bold serif title "Python Tracer".
    *   Beneath the title, the smaller, italicized gray text "sys.settrace".

A thin, medium-dark gray arrow continues the flow from the Python Tracer to the Raw Trace document.

**Element 3: Raw Trace**
*   **Shape and Style:** A single document icon with a neatly folded top-right corner. It has a warm cream background and contains four delicate wavy lines to suggest text.
*   **Labels:**
    *   The bold serif label "Raw Trace" is positioned **only above** the document icon.
    *   The smaller gray text "~2,000 tokens" is positioned **only below** the document icon.

**Element 4: Condition Cards (Central Group)**
This section features four distinct rectangular cards stacked vertically with consistent spacing. They represent different information densities derived from the trace.

*   **Connections to Cards:**
    *   Three gracefully curved, colored arrows fan out from the "Raw Trace" document, each pointing to one of the top three cards.
    *   A separate, **dashed gray arrow** originates from the initial "Input" box, bypassing the tracer, and points directly to the bottom "No Trace" card.

*   **Card A: Exception Only (Top Card)**
    *   **Style:** This is the "hero" card, visually emphasized with a wider format, a more pronounced drop shadow, and a prominent warm gold border. The background is a very light, buttery yellow.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "Exception Only" appears next to a small gold star icon.
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "type + stacktrace + message".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a solid gold background and white text displays "99.83%".

*   **Card B: VOTA**
    *   **Style:** A standard-width card with a solid, deep sage green accent bar on its left edge. The background is a complementary pale mint green.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "VOTA".
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "exceptions + assertions + loops".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a solid green background displays "99.05%".

*   **Card C: Full Trace**
    *   **Style:** A standard-width card with a warm, terracotta-brown accent bar on the left edge. The background is a soft peach color.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "Full Trace".
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "complete line-by-line trace".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a solid brown background displays "81.44%".

*   **Card D: No Trace (Bottom Card)**
    *   **Style:** A muted, baseline card defined by a dashed, medium-gray border and filled with a light, neutral gray.
    *   **Content:**
        *   The bold serif title "No Trace".
        *   A small, gray subtitle reads: "source code only".
        *   A pill-shaped badge with a solid gray background displays "75.13%".

Four arrows, colored to match the accent of each card (gold, green, brown, gray), emerge from the right of the cards and converge on the SFT Model.

**Element 5: SFT Model**
*   **Shape and Style:** A large, prominent rounded rectangle with a solid, deep plum-purple background.
*   **Content (all in light, contrasting text):**
    *   The large, bold, white title "SFT".
    *   Below, the text "LoRA fine-tuning" is rendered in a soft lavender.
    *   At the bottom, the text "1.5B - 13B" appears in the same soft lavender.

A single, solid dark arrow points from the SFT Model to the final Verdict.

**Element 6: Verdict (Rightmost)**
*   **Shape and Style:** A single rectangle, cleanly split horizontally into two equal halves.
*   **Content:**
    *   **Top Half:** A soft, light green background containing a green checkmark icon and the text "Pass".
    *   **Bottom Half:** A pale rose background with a red 'X' icon and the text "Fail".

**3. Annotations**
*   **Location:** Positioned at the bottom of the figure, spanning the width of the four condition cards.
*   **Content:**
    *   On the left, aligned with the cards: "← Information density decreases" in small, italic gray text.
    *   On the right, aligned with the cards: "Accuracy increases →" in small, italic gray text.
